Write R_+=[0,infinity), and let lambda_T be Lebesgue measure on [0,T], transported to R_+ (the given comap of volume restricted to [0,T]). All time integrals below use this measure unless indicated otherwise. A ProgressiveL2Integrand eta on horizon T is a real process eta(t,omega), strongly progressive for the filtration, with (omega,t) -> eta(t,omega) in L^2(mu x lambda_T). The named constructor local_symbol_a838c8d190eb packages the process sqrt(2*a(t))*[V_j(X(t,omega))]_i with progressive and L^2 proofs.

Domains: I finite with decidable equality; Omega measurable; filtration on R_+; finite mu; T>=0; X:R_+ x Omega->S; a:R_+->R; i,j in I; t>=0; omega in Omega.

Quantifiers: Universally all spaces and instances,filtration,mu,T,X,hX,hProgressive,a,hTemperature,i,j,t,omega in the displayed order.

Assumptions: X is jointly measurable and strongly progressive; a is continuous on R_+. No nonnegativity of a or positivity of T is assumed.

Conclusion: The process field of local_symbol_a838c8d190eb(T,X,...,a,...,i,j) at (t,omega) equals sqrt(2*a(t))*(delta_ij-X_j(t,omega)*X_i(t,omega)).

Scopes: Pointwise identity for all t and omega, with no t<=T restriction. The record certifies square integrability only on mu x lambda_T. Real.sqrt is defined to be zero for negative arguments.
